decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing fast mana generation and card draw to power out powerful spells, while also utilizing the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for extra value. The goal is to generate massive amounts of mana with rituals and medallions, then utilize cards like Glimpse the Impossible and Ral, Monsoon Mage to dig for combo pieces. Past in Flames ensures that resources can be reused, while Wish allows for flexibility in finding specific cards. Overall, the deck aims to generate a storm of spells quickly and overwhelm the opponent with sheer speed and power.

The core idea of this deck is to combo off quickly by generating mana with cards like Pyretic Ritual and Manamorphose, while also reducing the cost of spells with Ruby Medallion. Ral, Monsoon Mage is used as both a win condition and a way to filter through the deck for key combo pieces. The deck also utilizes Past in Flames to recur spells from the graveyard and has an additional win condition with Wish. The deck aims to storm off and win in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and creatures to outvalue the opponent and disrupt their game plan. It relies on a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane, along with hand disruption like Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also features powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Necrodominance to close out games. The mana base includes lands that provide flexibility and consistency in casting the spells needed to control the board and emerge victorious.

The deck focuses on efficiently generating mana with rituals and ramp spells to cast powerful red spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. The combo aspect comes from utilizing Glimpse the Impossible to draw cards and potentially combo off with Past in Flames. Additionally, the deck utilizes Wish to search for specific pieces needed to win the game. The inclusion of Reckless Impulse and Valakut Awakening help with card selection and hand manipulation. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build up resources to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells.

This deck aims to combo off by utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, eventually leading to a win condition with Thassa's Oracle or grinding out the opponent with Grinding Station. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber help to generate mana and card advantage, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Misty Rainforest enable deck manipulation. The deck also includes various utility lands and disruption spells to control the board and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The key strategy includes using creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters to deal damage quickly, alongside removal spells like Fatal Push and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary to clear the way. Utilizing the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an extra layer of flexibility and consistency to the deck. Overall, the goal is to maintain early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and finish the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Grief, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane. It aims to outvalue the opponent by recurring threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and using Necrodominance to cheat out powerful creatures. The deck also has ways to gain life and draw cards to outlast the opponent in a longer game. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to grind out resources and control the game until victory.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly to cast spells that allow for explosive turns, utilizing cards like Ruby Medallion, Pyretic Ritual, and Ral, Monsoon Mage to ramp up mana production. It aims to chain together spells such as Glimpse the Impossible, Manamorphose, and Reckless Impulse to draw cards and find combo pieces. The key strategy is to use Past in Flames to recur spells from the graveyard and continue the explosive combo turns. The deck also runs Wish and Valakut Awakening for additional utility and card advantage.

The deck revolves around assembling UrzaTron lands (Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana, allowing you to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Devourer of Destiny quickly. The deck also uses Karn, the Great Creator to lock down opponents' artifacts and disrupt their game plan. Additionally, Sowing Mycospawn can generate tokens to control the board, while Kozilek's Command and The One Ring provide additional removal and card advantage. The overall strategy is to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

The key concept of this deck is to deploy efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler early on, while disrupting the opponent with Counterspells and removal such as Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to pressure the opponent quickly and efficiently, while also controlling the board through countermagic and removal spells. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Subtlety provide additional threats and disruption, creating a versatile and aggressive game plan that can overwhelm the opponent in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 match.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temples and other ramp spells to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also utilizes control elements like All Is Dust to clear the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Through the Breach gives the deck a quick way to put Eldrazi onto the battlefield, while cards like Grove of the Burnwillows and Forest','','');">Karplusan Forest provide additional mana fixing. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big, hard-to-deal-with threats while controlling the game to ensure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the UrzaTron lands to produce large amounts of mana quickly. By doing so, the deck aims to play big threats like Emrakul, the World Anew and Karn, the Great Creator to dominate the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also incorporates powerful artifacts like The One Ring and The Underworld Cookbook to further enhance its control capabilities. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to establish a strong mana base and use it to play game-changing threats and control the game.

The main focus of this Mardu Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a variety of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Fatal Push. The deck also includes Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and Jegantha, the Wellspring as the companion to provide additional ramp and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, versatile, and disruptive in order to secure a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on creating a fast-paced and aggressive strategy by utilizing low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to remove threats and control the board. The deck features a companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value. With cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ocelot Pride to pump up creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and burn spells.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Boggart Trawler and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board. The deck also includes cards like Revitalizing Repast and Necrodominance to gain card advantage and maintain control of the game. The win condition of the deck is to drain the opponent's life total with Soul Spike and Fell the Profane, while also using March of Wretched Sorrow to finish off the opponent's remaining creatures.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and low-cost removal spells to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The deck includes cards that allow for flexibility in mana production, as well as disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. With a strong mix of aggressive creatures and control elements, this deck aims to overrun the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency and power to the deck's game plan.
